policy: New or expired HIGH/CRITICAL findings block, with or without a fix. Lower severities are advisory. No global ID suppressions.

exceptions.reason: EKS 1.35 uses default API envelope encryption (AWS-owned key for EKS >=1.28); this check requires an explicit encryption_config/CMK. See https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/envelope-encryption.html. No live verification or CMK guarantee is claimed.

Management TCP/443 egress reaches changing public SSM/ssmmessages, regional AWS APIs, S3 artifact objects and package registries via NAT, plus private EKS. Security groups cannot enforce DNS-name allowlists. No complete stable free prefix list covers these dependencies; DNS and PostgreSQL are separately scoped. Retain exact TCP/443 rule; no new endpoints/costs. Verify SSM, downloads and private rollout after reconstruction.

exceptions.resource: ClusterRole 'cluster-autoscaler' should not have access to resources ["services", "endpoints", "endpointslices", "networkpolicies", "ingresses"] for verbs ["create", "update", "patch", "delete", "deletecollection", "impersonate", "*"]
exceptions.reason: Chart 9.56.0 ClusterRole permits create/patch on core endpoints with events, and get/update only on the cluster-autoscaler Endpoints name. Services are read-only; there is no networkpolicy/ingress write grant in this role. These are upstream endpoint-lock compatibility permissions alongside current Lease rules; no supported chart value removes only these rules. Retain pending a separately tested controller-specific RBAC decision, rather than disable cluster-scoped node discovery or fork the chart.

exceptions.reason: Required certificate reconciliation, not a false positive. ESO writes only named validating webhooks/CRDs and its kube-system webhook Secret through parent-chart RBAC; local kind verified named allow/deny and regeneration of an invalid certificate. KEDA upstream minimal role patches admission CA and external metrics APIService; local admission/metrics/scale tests passed. No supported chart-only resourceNames restriction was found for its minimal role. Retain exact rules; live EKS networking remains untested.
